subtasks.title: D1/D2 — guard ManageZones::save() against an empty rebuilt geometry, and un-pin the bug from the test suite
subtasks.approach: Inside the existing DB::connection('platform')->transaction() in save(), immediately after $zone->rebuildGeometryFromDefinition(), re-read the row and check (geom IS NULL OR public.ST_IsEmpty(geom)) using the SAME rawValue idiom ZoneKmlImporter.php:64-72 already uses. When empty, resolve which of definition.zip_codes matched no tiger_data.zcta5_all row so the message can name them, then throw to roll the transaction back (no invisible zone row, and on the edit path the prior good geometry survives). Catch outside the transaction and re-surface as ValidationException::withMessages(['data.definition' => <actionable message>]) — the repo's existing Filament error idiom (app/Filament/Auth/CustomLoginPage.php:78), which lands on the same 'definition' form key the existing empty-definition rule uses, so test_empty_geometry_is_rejected's assertion style keeps working. Do NOT touch Zone::rebuildGeometryFromDefinition()'s never-throw contract — KmlZoneParser and ZoneKmlImporter depend on it, and the precedent puts the guard in the caller.

intended_diffs.app/Filament/Pages/ManageZones.php: save(): wrap the existing transaction call in try/catch for the new guard exception; add the post-rebuild emptiness check + unresolvable-zip resolution inside the transaction; on failure throw ValidationException on data.definition instead of falling through to the unconditional 'Zone saved' success notification at :325. Analytics/broadcast/notification must not fire on the failure path.
intended_diffs.tests/Filament/Pages/ManageZonesTest.php: Fix test_saves_a_zip_only_zone to seed tiger_data.zcta5_all for 75201 and assert geom is non-null and non-empty (it currently asserts neither, which is what pinned the bug). Add a sibling test that an UNRESOLVABLE zip is rejected with a form error on definition and persists no zone. Add a private seedTigerZip helper.
intended_diffs.tests/Models/ZoneTest.php: Pin the never-throw contract: an unmatched zip_codes entry leaves geom NULL and does not throw.

implementation_notes: CROSS-CONNECTION TRAP (will silently break the test if missed): config/database.php gives `zod` and `platform` the same database but different search_path, and they are SEPARATE PDO connections. tests/TestCase.php::connectionsToTransact() wraps both, so a row inserted on `zod` inside its own transaction is INVISIBLE to `platform`. rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() reads tiger_data.zcta5_all on the PLATFORM connection, so the tiger seed in ManageZonesTest MUST be inserted via DB::connection('platform'), NOT via 'zod' as ZoneZipSearchControllerTest does (that test reads back on 'zod' too, so it never hit this).
From the platform connection the search_path is `platform`, so spatial_ref_sys must be written schema-qualified as public.spatial_ref_sys; tiger_data.zcta5_all is already schema-qualified.

The SRID 4269 spatial_ref_sys insert is required — the test DB's spatial_ref_sys is pruned (see tests/Support/HasZodDatabase.php) and ST_Transform from 4269 needs the projection row. Copy the ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING insert from ZoneZipSearchControllerTest::seedTigerZip.

The seedTigerZip helper is duplicated into ManageZonesTest rather than extracted to a shared trait. Deliberate: extracting would mean editing ZoneZipSearchControllerTest, an unrelated currently-passing file outside this ticket's scope. Flagged here so review reads it as a trade-off, not an oversight.
Cover BOTH empty causes in the message: unresolvable zips (name them) and the polygons-only degenerate case (generic message). Do not assume zip_codes is non-empty.

subtasks.title: D3/D4 — stop the client accepting truncated ZIPs and silently substituting an unrelated ZIP's polygon
subtasks.approach: Two surgical edits in commitZipInput()/addZip(), then rebuild the tracked bundle. D3: the commit-time token filter runs on a COMMITTED token (Enter/comma/paste), not on progressive typing, so it must require a complete 5-digit ZIP — change /^\d{3,5}$/ to /^\d{5}$/ in both the validTokens and malformed expressions. D4: drop the `|| rows[0]` fallback so a non-exact match is reported as not_found, making addZip() exact-match-only exactly like its sibling hydrateZips():425. Leave the endpoint's prefix-LIKE contract alone — it is intentional and test-pinned for autocomplete (ZoneZipSearchControllerTest q=303).

intended_diffs.resources/js/components/zone-manager.js: :599-600 regex /^\d{3,5}$/ -> /^\d{5}$/ (both occurrences); :634 `const exact = rows.find(r => r.zip === token) || rows[0];` -> exact-match only, returning 'not_found' when absent.
intended_diffs.public/build/**: Regenerated by `npm run build` and committed — public/build is tracked in this repo, so an unrebuilt JS change ships nothing.

implementation_notes: After the rows[0] removal, `exact` can be undefined — return 'not_found' BEFORE dereferencing exact.zip/exact.geojson, or the change trades a wrong-area bug for a TypeError.
The existing caller already maps 'not_found' into the visible 'No boundary found for: <token>' message, so no message plumbing is needed for D4.

`npm run build` also runs scripts/version-sw.mjs, which rewrites the APP_VERSION stamp in public/clarity-scout-sw.js. That file is registered generated-noise (CLARITY_GENERATED_NOISE) and checkpoint.sh reverts it when the version stamp is the only change — do not hand-edit or fight it.

No JS unit-test runner exists in this repo (Playwright e2e only) and the Livewire tests set data.definition directly, bypassing this file. D3/D4 therefore CANNOT be pinned by the PHP suite and must be verified by browser QA in Phase 6.

subtasks.title: Q5 — same missing empty-geometry guard in RunArea Materializer, on a different table
subtasks.approach: Materializer::materialize() builds pieces from recognized inputs, unions them, and writes geometry + source_vintage + materialized_at = NOW() in one raw UPDATE. When a recognized entry resolves to NOTHING (a state/msa reference matching no tiger row), the subquery yields NULL, geometry is written NULL, and the metadata is still stamped — so the row claims to be materialized while carrying no boundary, and a previously-good geometry is overwritten with NULL. Wrap the UPDATE in a platform transaction, re-read (geometry IS NULL OR public.ST_IsEmpty(geometry)) with the same rawValue idiom, and throw RuntimeException when empty so the transaction rolls back: the stamp is not applied and any prior good geometry survives. The only production caller is the queued MaterializeOrgRunArea job, so the throw surfaces as a visible failed job — the loud signal this path currently lacks.

intended_diffs.app/Services/RunArea/Materializer.php: Wrap the existing UPDATE in DB::connection('platform')->transaction(); add the post-update emptiness check; throw RuntimeException naming the unresolved inputs on empty.
Add: a recognized entry that resolves to nothing (e.g. kind=state reference=ZZ) throws, leaves geometry NULL and does NOT stamp source_vintage/materialized_at; and a re-materialize that would resolve to nothing preserves the previously-materialized geometry instead of nulling it.

implementation_notes: Preserve the EXISTING contract the current tests pin: empty inputs (MaterializerTest:82) and unrecognized-kind-only inputs (:96) must still return early, leave geometry NULL, and NOT throw. The new throw applies only when pieces were actually built and the union still resolved to nothing — do not collapse these two cases.

Consumers degrade safely on a NULL geometry (ScoutMapHelpers::loadRunAreaForClip:146 falls back to the viewport bbox), so the user-visible harm here is silent non-clipping plus false materialized_at metadata plus the destructive overwrite — not a crash. Grade the severity accordingly; do not overstate it in the Build Record.
Throwing from a queued job means a retry/failed_jobs entry. That is the intended loud signal for a backend path with no UI, and mirrors ZoneKmlImporter's RuntimeException precedent.
